critical_code_review_comments: CurrencyStrengthIndex.jsx line 521: the <select> <option> text 'CODE · Name' uses non-ASCII middle-dot · embedded directly in string template — fine, but confirm cross-browser font rendering.

CurrencyStrengthIndex.jsx usdSynth: uses synthetic long/short proxies (longSyn/shortSyn) that are based on avgNet sign only — strength score for USD may underweight vs real currencies because their long+short totals are much larger. Consider computing USD long/short as sum of component shorts/longs for a more comparable denominator.

AssetCard.jsx InfoTooltip: position computed on open via getBoundingClientRect; does not re-position on window resize or scroll. Minor edge case — tooltip can become misaligned if user scrolls while hover is active.
